claims.head: Tired legs for the Ducks
claims.body: The Ducks played last night and get no rest before this one. Teams in that spot usually get the worse of the chances, so we expect the Flames to control more of the play than they usually do.
claims.call: The Flames get a bigger share of the 5-on-5 chances than they usually do.

CGY.head: The Flames face a real test
CGY.body: Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but they are on the second night of a back-to-back, and Calgary has home-ice advantage. The Flames can pull it off if they keep the shots coming.

ANA.head: The matchup suits the Ducks
ANA.body: Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but they are on the second night of a back-to-back, and Calgary has home-ice advantage. The Flames can make it interesting if they keep the shots coming.

story.head: The Flames try again for a first win
paras: The Flames are still looking for their first win of the season, 0-4-0 through four games. The Ducks are 3-1-0.
